## getSetterRatifierRatifyRootRequirement() function

Resolves the SetterRatifier root approval transaction for a maker offer tree.

Call after building a Setter-ratified tree and before encoding/submitting its payload. Entity make-offer flows call this from `getRequirements()` and omit the transaction when the maker has already approved the root.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getSetterRatifierRatifyRootRequirement: (params: GetSetterRatifierRatifyRootRequirementParams) => Promise<Readonly<Transaction<SetterRatifierRatifyRootAction>> | null>
```

Ratify-root transaction, or `null` when the root is already ratified.

## Exceptions

`ChainIdMismatchError` when the viem client is connected to another chain.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.viemClient`<!-- -->: Viem client used to read root approval state.

- `params.chainId`<!-- -->: Chain id expected by the viem client.

- `params.maker`<!-- -->: Maker whose root approval is checked.

- `params.root`<!-- -->: Offer-tree root that must be approved.

## Example


```ts
import { getSetterRatifierRatifyRootRequirement } from "@morpho-org/morpho-sdk";

const tx = await getSetterRatifierRatifyRootRequirement({
  viemClient: client,
  chainId: 8453,
  maker: user,
  root,
});
if (tx) {
  await walletClient.sendTransaction({
    to: tx.to,
    data: tx.data,
    value: tx.value,
  });
}
```
